format: UTF-8 CSV with header; all cells strings; exact columns; no extra fields

fiction_label.description: Mandatory standalone fiction label; never remove from fictional rows.
fiction_label.const: WHOLLY FICTIONAL TEACHING DATA — NOT REAL PROSPECTS OR CLIENT DATA

row_id.description: Unique supplied-row identifier, not a company count.

supplied_name.description: Unmistakable invented label; not a real business.

supplied_unit.description: Original incoming unit; preserve it even after operator resolution. A nonduplicate row with an attributed company_key anchors that company, whatever its incoming unit.

company_key.description: Resolved company identity; blank when unresolved. Group and site IDs are not company keys.

site_keys.description: Optional pipe-separated invented site keys. Keep sites under the company; do not count separately.

group_key.description: Optional invented parent-group ID; a shared group alone does not establish duplication.

identity.description: Company-to-evidence and company-to-site attribution. Pass requires a company key.

activity.description: Pass: makes complete food-packaging machinery; fail: positive evidence of excluded activity; unknown: not established.

territory.description: Pass: relevant manufacturing in Republic of Ireland; office-only presence fails this fictional brief.

exclusions.description: Pass: stipulated fictional existing-account/channel check clear; fail: evidenced exclusion; unknown: not checked.

source_use.description: Scenario-only permission for the declared simulated review, retention and customer-facing summary sharing. Pass is invented, never real permission; internal access alone is insufficient.

evidence_consistency.description: Pass: no unresolved material contradiction within stipulated evidence; conflict: material contradiction remains.

evidence_id.description: Invented evidence-card ID, NOT a retrieved citation.

evidence_text.description: Original invented statements supporting the gate values. A human must check semantic support.

source_url.description: Blank in this fictional exercise: no live source exists.

source_publication_date.description: Blank in fiction; never invent source dates.

source_review_date.description: Blank in fiction; test execution date is NOT a source review date.

project_status.description: Separate from account fit. Qualifying signal requires additional invented text, not equipment-fit validation.

project_evidence_text.description: Blank except for qualifying_signal_identified; then starts Invented signal: .

canonical_row_id.description: Only for confirmed surplus duplicates: direct pointer to a nonduplicate row with the same resolved company_key; its original supplied_unit need not be company.

dedup_evidence.description: Invented attribution: statement naming the exact company_key and anchor row ID and explaining same-company linkage. Token presence is not semantic proof.

next_check.description: Concrete unresolved verification question for holds; not an instruction to contact anyone.

brief_id.description: Fictional brief identifier bound to the exercise policy; not a live customer brief.

brief_version.description: Exact brief version shared by policy, rows and answer key. Changing the brief requires reassessment, not relabelling.

cross_field_rules: Policy, schema, batch and answer key use FIC-BRIEF-01 version 1; ruleset OG02-HOLD-FIRST-1. Unsupported contract changes are refused.

All row IDs unique; evidence IDs unique. Identity pass iff company_key nonblank. Identity unknown/conflict requires company-specific activity, territory and exclusions to remain unknown/conflict until attributable checks are made.

Each resolved company has exactly one nonduplicate anchor. Duplicates require the same company_key, direct nonduplicate target, matching consolidated gates/project status and an invented attribution naming that company and anchor.
Preserve supplied_name, supplied_unit, row_id and raw evidence. Resolved company_key supplies the assessment unit; resolving a brand or site must not overwrite its incoming unit.

This exercise assigns each site to at most one company; an unresolved site is allowed only while held and cannot also be assigned to a resolved company. Real shared-site cases need a different contract.

Decision order for this conservative teaching policy only: confirmed duplicate, otherwise material unknown/conflict hold, otherwise positive fail reject, otherwise include. This is not a universal rejection policy.

Duplicate rows mirror the consolidated account assessment, not independent local gate votes. Refuse stale mismatches. Preserve contradictory evidence and mark the relevant gate and evidence_consistency conflict across the group with a next check on the anchor; any conflicted gate requires evidence_consistency conflict. Duplicates can point to held or rejected anchors.
Only included anchors receive a class: qualifying_signal_identified => opportunity_signal; otherwise fit_matched_lookalike. No score override.
Signal text required iff status is qualifying_signal_identified. Fiction source URLs and dates remain blank; no real-source adapter supplied.
Reconciliation requires exactly one outcome per input row ID, known dispositions, and no class on duplicate/hold/reject. Balanced totals alone are insufficient.
Blank practice rows intentionally fail until completed. Expected counts describe the supplied worked batch only, not a new practice batch.
